title: When the Bridge Breaks
author: Jonah Dunmore
blurb: Petra Whitlock, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
